name: Renaud Regnery: 'The Weird and the Eerie'
description: Renaud Regnery presents 'The Weird and the Eerie' at Klemm's, an exhibition that runs from March 13 to April 18, 2026. The opening reception takes place on Friday, March 13 from 6–9pm. This exhibition promises to explore uncanny and disquieting aesthetic territories, offering a compelling visual investigation into the strange and the unsettling.
